subject: general
question: Which one of the following plant parts is NOT used for vegetative propagation?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Seed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vegetative propagation** involves the use of parts of a plant other than seeds to reproduce new plants.
 
• **Seeds** are used in **sexual reproduction**, not vegetative propagation.
 
• Common plant parts used in vegetative propagation include **stems, leaves, and roots**.
 
• **Stem cuttings** from plants like roses and hibiscus can be used to grow new plants.
 
• Certain plants like **succulents** can propagate from their **leaves**.
 
• **Root tubers** such as those from sweet potatoes can also be used for vegetative propagation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Stem**__

 __
 
• **Stem cuttings** are a popular method of vegetative propagation.
 
• Examples include plants like **roses, hibiscus, and sugarcane**.
 
 
 
• **Leaves**__
 __
 
• Certain plants like **succulents** can propagate from their leaves.
 
• Examples include **jade plant** and **kalanchoe**.
 
 
 
• **Root**__
 
 
• **Root tubers** such as sweet potatoes and **taproots** like carrots can be used for vegetative propagation.
